description:
Lee Ji-yeon is the most popular instructor at a cram school. At the podium, she shines brighter than anyone, but when she returns home, she is a wife who swallows her loneliness while being shunned by her husband. 

She herself did not want to reveal the emptiness hidden behind her glamorous career. The first to notice the gap was her student sitting in front of the podium. 

At first, she drew a line and pushed him away. However, once the line was broken, it did not return, and something greater than guilt began to consume her.
